method: One explicit retry of each unfinished baseline response at the provider ceiling; unchanged saved prompt and requirement. First 900-token attempts remain retained.

cases.requirement: In staging with 10,000 seeded products, run 100 concurrent virtual users for 10 minutes after a 2-minute warm-up. Each user sends one catalogue-search request every 5 seconds. During the measured 10 minutes, the 95th-percentile response time must be at most 800 ms and fewer than 1% of requests may fail.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve the dataset, concurrency, request interval, warm-up and measured duration. Use p95 <= 800 ms and failure rate < 1%, not averages or altered boundaries. Ask for endpoint and failure definition if absent. Do not claim measured results.
